name: Stolen Jewellery
description: Rings and a brooch with the owner's System tag scratched off. Honest traders won't touch it; the fence in the Undermarket will.

name: Warden's Seal
description: An iron seal stamped with the Ledger's mark, given to those who keep the record. Doors open for it; outlaws step aside.

name: Auditor's Ledger Page
description: A page torn from a High Auditor's ledger. Names, crimes, and one line about you, underlined twice.
